# Phi control verbs

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen-verbs-md.py from client/phi_verb_registry.cc — do not edit by hand. -->

Every verb the client serves on the `/phi-agent` control channel, read straight out of the C++ registry the dispatcher gates on. If a verb is not here it is not callable; if a field is not in a verb's payload table the verb does not read it.

## The wire

The channel speaks one of two protocols, chosen on the WebSocket upgrade and fixed for the connection's life. Send `X-Phi-Protocol: 2` to get the typed wire; the 101 echoes `X-Phi-Protocol: 2` back when the client understood it. Without the header (or without the echo) the connection speaks protocol 1, byte-compatible with every earlier build.

**Protocol 1** — the payload and the reply body are JSON *strings*:

```json
--> {"id":7,"type":"agentSpace.spaces.list","payloadJson":"{}"}
<-- {"id":7,"responseJson":"{\"ok\":true,\"spaces\":[…]}"}
<-- {"id":8,"responseJson":"{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"unknown_task\"}"}
<-- {"event":"agentSpace.ownershipChanged","payloadJson":"{…}"}
```

**Protocol 2** — objects, a closed error code, and no double encoding:

```json
--> {"id":7,"type":"agentSpace.spaces.list","payload":{}}
<-- {"id":7,"ok":true,"result":{"spaces":[…]}}
<-- {"id":8,"ok":false,"error":{"code":"unknown_task"}}
<-- {"id":9,"ok":false,"error":{"code":"invalid_payload","message":"missing required field `taskId`"}}
<-- {"event":"agentSpace.ownershipChanged","payload":{…}}
```

A verb that answers a finer token than its code keeps the token: protocol 1 puts it in `error`, protocol 2 puts the closed code in `error.code` and the token in `error.details.reason`. Any other fields a refusal carries ride alongside it in `error.details`.

A scoped verb whose `taskId`, `windowId` or `spaceId` names nothing live is refused with `unknown_task`, `window_not_open` or `space_not_open`, whether or not its row below lists the code.

## Verbs

158 rows, 155 distinct names.

### The agent-Space lifecycle

#### `agentSpace.ping` — the row claimed when the payload carries `taskId`

Refreshes a task's keep-alive.

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: agent, shadow — aimed with `taskId`, `windowId` or `spaceId`. A verb aimed at an agent or shadow window of the caller's OWN task needs only `agentSpace`.
- **Errors**: `unknown_task`, `not_owner`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `taskId` | string | yes | — | The task to keep alive. |
| `ttlSeconds` | number | no | — | Seconds of keep-alive; 0 keeps the current TTL. |

#### `agentSpace.ping`

Liveness probe: the app phase and how many saves are still coalescing.

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: app-wide.

*No payload fields.*

The caller's tasks, the open window slots, and whether the Agent Transcript console is watching.

#### `agentSpace.create`

Binds a task to an agent Space, creating its hidden window when there is none (or the old one went tabless).

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: agent, shadow — aimed with `taskId`, `windowId` or `spaceId`. A verb aimed at an agent or shadow window of the caller's OWN task needs only `agentSpace`.
- Answers asynchronously — the reply arrives when the work lands.
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `not_owner`, `busy`, `create_failed`, `create_timeout`, `profile_not_agent_allowed`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `taskId` | string | yes | — | The task to bind or create. |
| `profileId` | string | no | `profileName` | The profile the Space runs in. |
| `persistent` | boolean | no | — | Keep the window when the task completes. |
| `agentName` | string | no | — | The driving agent's product name ("Claude Code", "Codex", "Pi", …): the Space's pip wears that agent's mark and the watch pill names it. |

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `taskId` | string | yes | — | The task to complete. |
| `status` | string | no | — | "success" (default) or anything else for a failure. |
| `keep` | boolean | no | — | Keep a persistent Space's window (default true). |
| `message` | string | no | — | A closing line for the transcript (a failure's reason). |

| `themeId` | string | no | — | A built-in theme by id or name (pure mist mint aqua iris petal coral amber); an agent's Space pins the app-wide theme when neither this nor colorHex is given. |
| `colorHex` | string | no | — | "#RRGGBB", snapped to the nearest built-in theme by hue (themeId wins). |
| `iconName` | string | no | — | A phi: icon, a bare catalog name, an emoji:<codepoints> or the emoji itself; a random catalog draw when absent. |

#### `agentSpace.spaces.openTab`

Opens a tab in a user Space's window, bypassing url routing. A Space with no window gets one first (surfaced when activate, else behind the user's windows without taking focus) and the reply says windowOpened:true; a New Tab URL is then the window's own seed tab. A windowId never opens one.

- **Capabilities**: `userSpaceWrite`
- **Scope**: agent, shadow, user — aimed with `taskId`, `windowId` or `spaceId`. A verb aimed at an agent or shadow window of the caller's OWN task needs only `agentSpace`.
- Mutates the user's state (arms the agent drive context).
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `unknown_space`, `window_not_open`, `create_failed`, `create_timeout`, `user_space_operations_disabled`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | no | `space` | The Space's open window. |
| `windowId` | integer | no | — | That window, directly. |
| `url` | string | yes | — | Where the new tab goes. |
| `activate` | boolean | no | — | Leave the new tab selected (default true). |

#### `agentSpace.spaces.focus`

What the foreground window is showing — the orientation read every round starts with.

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- **Errors**: `no_window`

*No payload fields.*

#### `agentSpace.spaces.activate`

Surfaces a Space in whichever window already hosts it, else in the focused one; with no user window open at all there is nothing to switch (spaces.openTab opens one).

- **Capabilities**: `userSpaceWrite`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- Mutates the user's state (arms the agent drive context).
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `unknown_space`, `no_focused_window`, `user_space_operations_disabled`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | yes | `space` | The Space. |

#### `agentSpace.spaces.update`

Renames, re-icons or re-themes a Space in one call, validating every field before writing any; answers the themeId (and iconName) that landed.

- **Capabilities**: `userSpaceWrite`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- Mutates the user's state (arms the agent drive context).
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `unknown_space`, `unknown_theme`, `invalid_color`, `invalid_icon`, `user_space_operations_disabled`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | yes | `space` | The Space. |
| `name` | string | no | `displayName` | Its new name. |
| `themeId` | string | no | — | A built-in theme by id or name to pin. |
| `colorHex` | string | no | — | "#RRGGBB", snapped to the nearest built-in theme by hue (themeId wins). |
| `iconName` | string | no | — | A phi: icon, a bare catalog name, an emoji:<codepoints> or the emoji itself. |

| `guid` | string | yes | — | The download. |

#### `agentSpace.sync.keyOp`

Starts one sync key-layer operation (the setup window's and Settings ▸ Sync's steps); agentSpace.sync.status's lastOp reports the outcome.

- **Capabilities**: `host`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- **Errors**: `test_rig_only`, `invalid_payload`, `no_key_layer`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `op` | string | yes | — | unlock, resolve, beginSetup, bootstrap, requestJoin, pollJoin, cancelJoin, recover, startPairing, applyDecisions, refresh, approve, deny, removeDevice, resetAccount (the last active device deletes the account's sync data, then removes itself), peek (read-only: the account's Phi sync data), syncNow (a Phi native sync round). |
| `requestId` | string | no | — | pollJoin / cancelJoin / approve / deny: the join request. |
| `code` | string | no | — | recover: the recovery code. |
| `confirm` | string | no | — | bootstrap: must be "bootstrap" (it creates the account's keys). |
| `decisions` | list | no | — | applyDecisions: [{kind: adopt\|registerNew\|createLocal, localProfileId, remoteUuid, displayName}]. |

### Credentials

#### `credentials.status`

Whether the vault is there, unlocked and ready.

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- **Errors**: `not_installed`

*No payload fields.*

#### `credentials.get`

Reveals a credential TO the agent, behind the user's approval.

- **Capabilities**: `credentialReveal`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- Shows the user a prompt; serialised so two never stack.
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `fill_requires_autofill`, `not_installed`, `not_ready`, `not_found`, `ambiguous`, `provider_error`, `user_denied`, `capability_required`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | object | no | — | {domain\|id\|search\|username} — the item to look up. |
| `domain` | string | no | — | A bare domain, when no `query` is given. |
| `mode` | string | no | — | "fill" is refused here: a fill is credentials.autofill's job. |
| `fields` | string[] | no | — | Which fields to return; a type default when absent. |
| `purpose` | string | no | — | Shown in the approval prompt. |

#### `credentials.getTotp`

Withdrawn: a second factor handed to an agent that already holds the first is worth nothing.

- **Capabilities**: `credentialReveal`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- **Errors**: `totp_not_supported`

*No payload fields.*

#### `credentials.autofill`

Fills a tagged field on a page — the secret goes vault → framework → DOM and never to the agent.

- **Capabilities**: `credentialFill`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- Shows the user a prompt; serialised so two never stack.
- **Errors**: `invalid_payload`, `not_installed`, `not_ready`, `not_found`, `ambiguous`, `provider_error`, `not_a_login`, `field_unavailable`, `origin_mismatch`, `origin_changed`, `user_denied`, `target_not_found`, `page_not_found`, `autofill_not_available`, `capability_required`, `scope_not_allowed`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | object | no | — | {domain\|id\|search\|username}. |
| `domain` | string | no | — | A bare domain. |
| `token` | string | yes | — | The tagged field's token. |
| `targetId` | string | yes | — | The page's CDP target. |
| `field` | string | no | — | password (default) or username. |
| `allowCrossOrigin` | boolean | no | — | Allow a fill whose item does not belong to the page's host. |

### Notification cards

#### `notification.show`

Shows the user a card (title, message, one button) without taking focus; answers {notificationId} on queue insertion. The decision — accept (the button), reject (the close button) or timeout (expiry, or eviction from the shared five-card queue) — arrives later as a notification.response event {notificationId, decision} on this agent session's live connections only; hiding the stack decides nothing. Subscribe before sending.

- **Capabilities**: `agentSpace`
- **Scope**: app-wide.
- **Errors**: `invalid_params`, `agent_session_required`

| field | type | required | also accepts | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | no | — | The card's title (nonblank). |
| `message` | string | no | — | The card's message (nonblank). |
| `buttonTitle` | string | no | — | The accept button's label (default Run). |
| `expiresInSeconds` | number | no | — | Whole seconds, 1 to 86400 (default 300); the card then answers timeout. |
